map.饮水提醒时间表（按目标与间隔生成） 使用指南: Water Intake Reminder Schedule (by Target and Interval) User Guide
map.输入：单次 250ml、每日目标 2000ml、间隔 60 分钟。\n全天杯数=:
Input: 250ml each time, a daily target of 2000ml, an interval of 60 minutes.
Cups for the day = target / each = 2000/250 = 8 cups; one cup every 60 minutes starting from the first, so coverage = (8−1)×60 = 420 …
map.按每日饮水目标与单次饮水量，生成均匀分布的多杯喝水提醒时间表。: Generate an evenly spaced multi-cup water reminder schedule from the daily target and the size of each drink.
map.久坐办公/健身人群用固定间隔提醒，避免一次性猛灌或全天缺水。: A fixed interval suits people who sit at a desk a lot or exercise, avoiding one big gulp or a whole day without water.
map.结合训练日额外补水需求，调整目标总量与提醒频次。: Allow for the extra water needs of training days by adjusting the target total and the reminder frequency.
map.可复现算例：目标 2000ml、每次 250ml、间隔 60 分钟: Reproducible example: target 2000ml, 250ml each time, interval 60 minutes
map.运动量大或炎热时可达 3000ml+；肾病/心衰等限水人群应遵循医嘱，不宜套用本: With heavy exercise or in hot weather it can reach 3000 ml or more; people on fluid restriction for kidney disease or heart failure should follow medical advice rather than apply this table
map.分次少量更利于吸收与肾脏调节，避免血液瞬间稀释与频繁排尿；运动中也建议每 15–: Several smaller amounts are easier to absorb and easier on the kidneys, avoiding sudden dilution of the blood and frequent urination; during exercise it is better to top up 150-200ml every 15-20 minutes rather than waiting until you are thirsty and gulping
map.每天一定要喝 2000ml 吗？: Do I have to drink exactly 2000 ml a day?
map.2000ml 是通用参考值，实际需求随体重、气温、运动量变化（常按 30–35m: 2000 ml is a general reference; actual needs vary with body weight, temperature and activity (often taken as 30-35 ml/kg). With heavy exercise or in hot weather it can reach 3000 ml or more; people on fluid restriction for kidney disease or heart failure should follow medical advice rather than apply this table.
map.一次喝很多和分次喝有区别吗？: Is there a difference between drinking it all at once and drinking it in several goes?
map.分次少量更利于吸收与肾脏调节，避免血液瞬间稀释与频繁排尿；运动中也建议每 15–: Several smaller amounts are easier to absorb and easier on the kidneys, avoiding sudden dilution of the blood and frequent urination; during exercise it is better to top up 150-200ml every 15-20 minutes rather than waiting until you are thirsty and gulping.
